headlines.title: 뷰런테크놀로지, 3차원 라이다 AI 소프트웨어 ‘룩아웃’ 조달청 혁신제품 지정

headlines.title: Baltic Dry Index Falls to 4-Week Low
headlines.content_summary: The Baltic dry index fell 1.2% to 2,632 on Wednesday, its lowest in four weeks. The capesize index, which typically transports 150,000 ton cargoes, including iron ore and coal declined 1.8% to 4,067, its lowest since July 21.
